entries.heading: None of the funds made available in this Act may be used
ancestors: DIVISION A—DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2019
entries.text:
Sec. 402.  None of the funds made available in this Act may be used 
by U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services to grant an immigration 
benefit unless the results of background checks required by law to be 
completed prior to the granting of the benefit have been received by 
U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services, and the results do not 
preclude the granting of the benefit.

entries.heading: No part of any appropriation contained in this Act shall
ancestors: DIVISION E—DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR, ENVIRONMENT, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2019
entries.text:
Sec. 402.  No part of any appropriation contained in this Act shall 
remain available for obligation beyond the current fiscal year unless 
expressly so provided herein.

entries.heading: None of the funds appropriated in this Act shall remain
ancestors: DIVISION G—TRANSPORTATION, HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2019
entries.text:
Sec. 402.  None of the funds appropriated in this Act shall remain 
available for obligation beyond the current fiscal year, nor may any be 
transferred to other appropriations, unless expressly so provided 
herein.
